name: real_world_modi_pstack_crossgate_high_budget_20260723
description: High-budget VISSIM adapter tuning for cross-gate/b13 Numerical-Sim P-Stack smoke validation. This intentionally opens horizon, candidate, Nash, and fallback budgets before later pruning.
notes: Use only for short VISSIM smoke runs; it deliberately spends more Python controller time.
Offset remains bounded to 15 s per control interval, but H=3 lets the controller score multi-interval phase effects instead of the old H=1 myopic setting.
After action diagnostics confirm the new budget is active, reduce candidate/Nash budgets for production runs.
